description: This file implements a Sentry integration class for frame processor metrics, enabling performance monitoring and debugging via Sentry transactions. It manages setup, cleanup, and transaction handling for TTFB and processing metrics, utilizing asyncio and the sentry_sdk.

classes.name: SentryMetrics
classes.description: A class extending FrameProcessorMetrics to integrate Sentry performance monitoring for frame processing metrics, including TTFB and processing transactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SentryMetrics object, setting up internal state and verifying Sentry SDK initialization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Sentry metrics system, creating a queue and background task if Sentry is available.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up Sentry resources, flushing pending transactions before shutdown.

methods.name: start_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Starts tracking TTFB metrics by creating a Sentry transaction if enabled.

methods.name: stop_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Stops TTFB metrics tracking and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: start_processing_metrics
methods.description: Starts tracking frame processing metrics with a new Sentry transaction.

methods.name: stop_processing_metrics
methods.description: Stops processing metrics tracking and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: _sentry_task_handler
methods.description: Background task that processes completed Sentry transactions from the queue and finalizes them.
